**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `eb37f6a4aa586205da2711b0fc297c0efdf4759b`.

Reviewed `0eb47a4..eb37f6a`: harness fix 6c01d4ba plus previously reviewed main changes. Manual tool only: **no new timer, retry/poll loop or per-seat/per-tick cost**.

The baseline remains **8 git + 1 gh + optional built parser** per ordinary complete CLI run. Ordering job IDs parses the existing check URLs; Delivers fallback reads the already-fetched latest-check map, with no new gh/API invocation.

**New local git work:** each matching-name, detached, correct-head review-worktree candidate gets status --porcelain, stopping at the first usable one. Let S be those status probes: ordinary run is **8+S git calls**. --worktree repeats worktree list and candidate inspection, then either reuses/refuses or adds one detached worktree. With one clean existing candidate, ordinary mode is **9 git**, and --worktree reuse **11 git**, plus gh/parser. Fresh creation with no candidate is **10 git**. Multiple unusable matching candidates make the status count input-dependent; the old fixed maximum of 12 direct calls is superseded, not a universal ceiling.

Filesystem realpath checks add two local path resolutions to CLI/import detection. The symlink regression starts one tsx child in the test; no live freeze command was run here. No implicit dependency install or parser build.

**P157-N001:** latestChecks groups runs with an array spread on every insertion, copying earlier entries repeatedly: O(sum(r_name^2)) shallow copying before linear selection. Normal small rollups make this minor and command-local, not a cost blocker; push into the group would avoid it if superseded history grows.

Prior limits stand: synchronous commands lack explicit deadlines; status may scan tracked/untracked worktree content; fetch/checkout bytes and git/gh descendant work are not bounded by Runner-call count; captured output is capped at 64 MiB per stream, not total parsed memory.

**CI:** exact head is CLEAN after GitHub's initial UNKNOWN recomputation. [CI 42391070697](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42391070697) succeeds in all four jobs. Node 22 executes **21 freeze tests**, including queued/null timestamp handling, job-id ordering, absent/failed/queued Delivers fallback, clean/detached worktree reuse/refusal and an actual symlinked CLI bad-usage invocation. Complete Vitest: **2,225 passed / 6 skipped**. Latest delivers **42391071598** passes; **42391070680** was cancelled.

Tests fake gh/git/parser and do not measure live network or worktree-scan latency. Author-reported mutations were not rerun. No local build, test, freeze run, runtime probe or worktree edit. Reviewer/security own FINAL and argument-safety correctness; this is a cost verdict, with no daemon after-deploy obligation.
